environment.release_boundary: probe process exit after device synchronization and output retention

plan.question: Within two fixed logical M=N families, where do WMMA exact residuals first appear across K0..16 while scalar controls and input snapshots remain retained?

estimands.primary: For each complete family scan and run order, smallest tested K with any observed WMMA mismatch, and separately smallest tested K with a C00 mismatch.
estimands.cross_family: At each fixed K, compare actual C00 words with the invariant row0/col0 reference; do not assume singleton and dense responses agree.

plan.trace_selection: Preselected singleton K16 and dense K16, both WMMA-first; not selected after observing residuals.
plan.acceptance: Retain complete numerical failure with the exact oracle unchanged. Structural, input-snapshot or guard corruption stops subsequent stages. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome.
limitations: A minimum is only within the complete declared family/K0..16 scan, not a global minimal counterexample.
Three input snapshots establish capture-boundary equality only; no transient-input or unique hardware-cause claim.
Scalar source is not a forced ISA implementation; unchanged kernel source does not establish unchanged binary.
Legacy and paired regressions remain auxiliary observations. No accepted timings or speedup ratios.

invalid_cases.expected_refusal: Shape, suite or family outside the fixed WMMA prefix cases
Shape, suite or family outside the fixed WMMA prefix cases

correctness.tested_contract: All captured input halfwords equal prepared/fixed packing; every full 16x16 FP32 output is finite and exactly equal to the logical integer dot /256, signed zeros equivalent; all guards intact.
correctness.analysis_scope: complete frozen checker replay for all actual inputs, snapshots and outputs; independent logical C00 formula and cross-family input-slice comparisons
correctness.expected_launch_count_scope: sum of the frozen per-variant declared launch counts, not a profiler count for every unprofiled launch

measurement.scope: raw complete-kernel event/host samples retained only for diagnostic provenance; no speedup, throughput or accepted performance
measurement.trace_scope: two preselected K16 pairs; each has separate110-event WMMA/scalar groups and its own ten warmups per group

artifacts.public_projection: all94 logical cases /176 complete output arrays,192512 prepared input halfwords,503808 captured halfwords,45056 payload+22528 guard words,1760 raw batches, frozen checker replay and two grouped traces

limitations: Earliest-K results are defined only over each complete predeclared family/K0..16 scan and recorded variant order, not a global minimal counterexample.
The complete K curves are retained; no monotonic progression of residuals is assumed.
Any-output mismatch covers all256 physical payload coordinates, while C00 mismatch is a separate condition; guard integrity is checked separately.

Singleton and dense cases share the captured A row0/B column0 inputs and reference C00, while other tile elements differ. Output agreement or disagreement does not by itself identify an arithmetic mechanism.
Prepared inputs and three device snapshots establish equality at capture boundaries only, not transient kernel inputs.
Scalar-source float operations do not establish a forced instruction sequence or prohibition of contraction; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged binaries.
Legacy regressions and profiled K16 pairs remain separate from the two unprofiled prefix curves.
All observed exact-contract failures remain failed. No tolerance, timing acceptance, speedup or throughput conclusion is introduced.
One C550/native software stack, deterministic packed dyadic FP16 input and a complete16x16 physical tile; no arbitrary-input or target-framework GEMM qualification.
